{{Quote|Kind of hot out here. Think I might head back to my quarters and lie down for a bit.|Moroni under the influence of Ferus Olin's Jedi mind trick|<ref name="Rebel Force: Uprising" />}}
'''Jono Moroni''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] janitor who served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Station]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. He had overheard information about a secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] meeting, information the Rebels had intercepted. [[Ferus Olin]], Moroni's friend a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] now allied with the Rebellion, used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to force Moroni to tell him about the information. Olin then suggested Moroni return to his quarters. Even though Olin confronted Rebel [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] about his instincts regarding the message, the Rebels went on to fall into the [[Battle of the Sixela system|trap]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] drew them into with the message.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Could be I heard something, while I was mopping up.|Moroni hesitantly speaks while under the influence of Ferus Olin's Jedi mind trick|<ref name="Rebel Force: Uprising" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Jono Moroni, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on their [[Great Temple/Legends|hidden fortress]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. A quiet man, he had red hair and was the sort to fade into the background, yet could talk for hours. Moroni primarily worked with the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] doing janitorial work. In his time on Yavin 4, he had a bout with [[Balmorra flu]].<ref name="Rebel Force: Uprising" />

One day, he was walking in the jungle outside the base and ran into two other Rebels, [[Ferus Olin]] and [[Lune Oddo Divinian|Div]]. Unbeknownst to Moroni, Olin was a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]; now Olin was just an old man. When Moroni and Olin were talking about the weather, Olin used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to influence Moroni to tell him about the recent activity at the Rebel base. Moroni let slip that the Rebels had intercepted a top-secret message from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] describing an upcoming meeting between the [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] and [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The meeting would have been protected by two [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyers]]. Moroni then went on to say [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] planned on taking out the Empire's leadership in one shot.<ref name="Rebel Force: Uprising" />

Olin thanked Moroni and used the mind trick to suggest Moroni go back to his quarters and lie down. Still under the influence of the mind trick, Moroni complained about the heat and went back to his quarters to lie down. Div scowled at Olin for using his mind tricks on a friend, and Olin silently apologized to Moroni. Using the information he acquired, Olin confronted General Dodonna, who told him that the Rebels were going to [[Battle of the Sixela system|attack the meeting]] in two weeks. Although Olin thought the battle was a trap, Dodonna did not trust Olin's instincts and insisted the attack go ahead. In the end, the battle did prove to be a trap by the rogue Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]]; Soresh and Olin both perished in the [[Supernova/Legends|conflagration]] instigated by Soresh.<ref name="Rebel Force: Uprising" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Good afternoon, Jono. How goes it?""<br />""Couldn't be better.|Ferus Olin to Moroni|<ref name="Rebel Force: Uprising" />}}
Physically, Moroni was a scruffy redhead. A quiet man, he faded into the background, yet could talk for hours if one engaged him. Ferus Olin described him as unfailingly friendly and cheerful. In the background, Moroni saw more than people thought he did, and wasn't unwilling to pass it along. It was obvious nothing made him happier than serving the Rebellion, even doing janitorial work.<ref name="Rebel Force: Uprising" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jono Moroni appears in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2010]] book ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''.
